To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have studied Ca-Ca collisions using QMD model at different bombarding energies and at different impact parameters.
the quantum molecular dynamics model can reproduce the experimental results of the Ca-Ca system at all energies.
the incomplete fusion events are found at low energies, and the onset of multifragment and vaporization events are seen at higher energies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the onset of incomplete fusion, multifragmentation and the onset of vaporization.
the study of the incomplete fusion, multifragmentation and onset of vaporization of Ca-Ca systems at different impact parameters and at different bombarding energies.
the study of incomplete fusion and the onset of multifragment production and vaporization in heavy-ion collisions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the onset of multifragment emission and vaporization in Ca-Ca collision is observed at a bombarding energy of about 100 A MeV and an impact parameter of b=4.0 fm.
the onset of multifragment production is a gradual phenomenon and the onset of complete vaporization is a sudden one.
at lower incident energies the incomplete fusion dominates the production of light mass fragments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

at lower incident energy (E/A=20 Me V) we have incomplete fusion, at intermediate energies (E/A=100 MeV) the binary break-up is the dominant process, at higher energies (E/A>150 MeV) the IMF production is the dominant process and at the highest energy (E/A = 1000 MeV) the vaporization is the dominating process.
the incomplete fusion, onset, and vaporization are the three important features that are observed in the present study.
the onset of multifragment emission is a function of the excitation energy of the system, which depends upon the incident energy and the impact parameter of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the incomplete fusion and the onset of multifragment production are not correlated in Ca-Ca collision system.
, the IMF production is more sensitive to the impact parameter than that of light mass fragment production.
the onset of multifragment emission is a gradual process.
